description: Line effects of weapons: the Hyper Blaster beam and the spark line. texture.page is the game's texture page word, palette [x, y] in video memory; the palette row grows by one every 2^palette_slot_shift depth slots. slots: depth slots (screen z / 8) a line is drawn in. maps_without_beams: maps where no beam is drawn. Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.

hyper_blaster.description: The beam is cut into segments of 1/2^segment_shift of the weapon's range up to the hit (one per metre of the hit distance, plus one) or segments_without_hit when it hits nothing; brightness starts at intensity_start and drops by intensity_step per segment; channels and tip colors are listed per beam colour option (red, yellow, green).

spark_line.description: Colour by the map's light mode (from the map header): null keeps whatever colour the primitive had (as the original), by_flashlight is lit, or dim where the flashlight is allowed but off and the environment is dark.
